an7.35:1.1: Imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññatarā devatā . . . pe . . .
an7.35:1.2: maṃ etad avoca ‘satt' ime bhante dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
an7.35:1.4: Satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, sovacassatā, kalyāṇamittatā.
an7.35:1.5: Ime kho bhante satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī' ti.
an7.35:1.7: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyī ti. 2.
an7.35:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 3.
an7.35:2.2: Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an7.35:2.3: Idha bhante bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī,
an7.35:2.4: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti,
an7.35:2.5: ye c' aññe bhikkhū satthugāravā tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an7.35:2.12: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti,
an7.35:2.13: ye c' aññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an7.35:2.14: Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī ti. 4.
an7.35:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ Sāriputta imassa mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
an7.35:3.3: Idha Sāriputta bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī,
an7.35:3.4: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti,
an7.35:3.5: ye c' aññe bhikkhū satthugāravā tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an7.35:3.12: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti,
an7.35:3.13: ye c' aññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an7.35:3.14: Imassa kho Sāriputta mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo
